strings.en: 1. Akito's Aestivalis reaches the ruins
1. Akito's Aestivalis is destroyed 2. Akatsuki's Aestivalis is destroyed
All units, escort Tenkawa's unit
until it reaches the ruins.
The units deployed there... are our company's mass-produced Aestivalis.
When did he order so many of them...
Heh, quite a long lecture... but in the end, it still comes down to fists.
...It's sad, but...
Akito, go for it!
What on earth is in those ruins...
And... how did Inez even get into those ruins...?
Most likely, she too, just like Tenkawa...
You mean she can Boson Jump?
I can see no other explanation.
The question is what she intends to show Tenkawa at the ruins...
We'll find out once we get there, that's what.
Destroying it will have to wait till after, though...
Hey, no need to rush. We'll lend a hand.
No no, everyone, cultural heritage must be treasured!
Oh my, you listened so quietly earlier, I thought you'd mellowed out...
So the chairman of a major corporation isn't that soft.
Akatsuki!
Oho, the chairman himself makes an appearance.
Now now, Banjo, we're both in tough positions here,
so can't you understand? ...If the Boson Jump system is unraveled,
I could consider giving the Haran Zaibatsu priority access, you know?
Heh, quite an attractive offer...
But I can't see corporate interests taking priority over peace
between Earth and Jupiter.
Quite so. Corporate profits exist only
because there is a civilian consumer market.
Akatsuki, please. We have to destroy the ruins,
we have to end the war...
Is that your way of "being true to yourself"? Hah, you people really are
Gekiganger through and through!
What was that!? ...I've already thrown Gekiganger away!
What!?
Tenkawa?
Ohhh?
Big Bro Akito...?
I figured it out when I saw those Jovians!!
Figured out what!?
That's what the thing I loved so much really was.
It's an enemy I have to defeat!
That's what I mean by "a one-sided view."
Listen. Just as every person has their own position,
they each have their own sense of justice.
Hm...
Colonel...
By the way, in the anime I liked, both the enemies and the heroes
had their own justice! You should've watched more anime.
And besides...
...What!
Don't underestimate the adult world, kid.
Sh-Shut uuup! Anime's got nothing to do with it anymore!!
I don't want anyone to suffer anymore. Not anyone!!
Akito...
Akito...
Oh well... can't be helped. Looks like force
is the only option after all!
It's no use with this guy. He's totally raring to go.
Hey, you've been with us all this time and don't know what we can do?
That's right! You'd better be careful you don't
get hurt yourselves!
Oh my, I'm picking a fight with you lot, after all.
Of course I came prepared.
So they've been upgraded that much...!
That's right. And this Aestivalis team has been tuned up
a cut above the ones aboard the Nadesico, so watch yourselves.
Plus, they all run on Nergal's pride and joy: high-performance AI!
Artificial intelligence...? I see, clever.
Tch! Yesterday the Meganoids, today Nergal?
I'm starting to lose track of what we're even fighting for...
If you ask what for, I'll answer: for myself.
In the jaws of death lies life; the unseen comes into view...
My, Izumi, you're quite the poet today.
Heh... Maki the poet, at your service. A poet and I didn't know it... heh...
...She's hopeless.
This is no time to be playing the ukulele! Here they come!
Get outta my way!
No can do. That's what they call grown-up circumstances!
Everyone, cover Tenkawa!
What about Nagare Akatsuki?
...I'd hate to shoot him down, though?
...Don't touch him until Tenkawa's unit reaches the ruins!
There's a mountain of things we need to ask him.
Roger!
I'm so grateful I could cry. ...Now, how long can I hold out...?
No good! Tsukiomi, get out!
Ngh... Shiratori... Are you saying your justice was right...
Nngh, justice... Justice is on our side...!
There's no way we can lose...!
Shut up! Someone who'd kill his own comrades and use them
has no right to talk about Gekiganger!
Justice...! There is only one justice... and it is ours!
Uooh! Th-This is bad!
Akiyama!
Captaaain!
No choice, I'm bailing out!
C-Captain!
Saburota, don't push it! Get out!
S-Sorry, Captain... Bailing out!
Wha...! Well, this is a fine mess...
End war for the good of the world and its people? How noble of you all!!
Shut up! Someone like you...!
Everyone's fighting for the world, the people, their country? For Earth?
That kind of thinking makes me sick!
Tenkawa has reached the ruins.
All right, all units, defend the ruins.
No need for that.
Huh?
Tenkawa's gone inside the ruins. I've no intention of destroying them.
Akatsuki...
Let's stop the pointless fighting, is all. With Akito and Inez down there,
you can't attack either, right? So let's just wait and see for a while.
Smooth as ever. Well, I'm sure this was all within his predictions.
Hm? What do you mean, Hayato?
It means Akatsuki knew this would happen, Ryoma.
That's why he used AI instead of soldiers to pilot
his mass-produced robots.
...You saw right through me, huh. As expected of Duke Fleed.
A man who sees both his own justice and others' is something else.
Akatsuki... Did you, maybe, do that so...
Whoa now, please don't. I'd hate for you
to think I'm that soft. ...But Inez,
just who are you planning to "welcome"?
Who knows...
Ai? Who's that?
Come on, another name we've never heard of, this late in the game!?
Allow me to explain.
Whoa, Ruri's doing it?
Since Auntie Explainer won't open a channel, I'll fill in.
Ai is a girl Akito met before he Boson Jumped from Mars
to Earth. Being unable to save her
became one of his traumas.
So that happened to Tenkawa...
But Ai didn't die.
Big Bro isn't coming...
He'll be here soon, so wait... What's wrong?
Auntie, you smell nice...
"Auntie" is a bit harsh.
You smell like Mommy! Mommy's so mean. When it all went kaboom,
she fell asleep with everyone. Then Big Bro started glowing,
and I felt like he'd go away somewhere, and so...
What!?
Two battleships... It's a Boson Jump!
Enemy forces analyzed. It's that "Nadesico" and the crane-class ship!
Captain! Now we can repay them for last time!
I know! Now then, that fine fellow,
how will he play it this time?
Prepare humanoid and insect-type fighters for immediate launch.
I'm going out too.
Earthlings... I won't hand the ruins over to you!
Auntie!
It's okay, it's okay... Nadesico, what's going on out there?
Inez! It's terrible, the Jovians
suddenly attacked with Tulips!
I see. Boson Jumps happening one after another nearby
are making the ruins active.
Auntie, I'm scared... I'm scared...
Akito, hurry!! Otherwise, Ai will
Boson Jump again...!
Ai, wait for meee!
Ah. Auntie, no! I haven't seen Big Bro yet,
not yet...
You will... Even if not now, you'll see him again, I promise!
You're a strong girl, aren't you? So believe... and don't forget.
His face... his voice... No matter what happens...
don't forget, don't ever forget.
...Okay. It's like I'm talking with Mommy...
Ai!! Inez, where's Ai!?
You just missed her... That's why I told you to hurry, but
well, maybe this is for the best...
Chase two hares and you'll catch neither!!
We'll take down that formidable Nadesico in one go! Saburota!
I know!
Bright...
Bright, what do we do...
If only those ruins were gone, the war would be over too...
...There is... a way.
What did you say?
But for that, we have to deal with the enemy first...
Ha! With all this complicated talk, I didn't know what to do!
But that, I can handle!
...We'll crush them...!
If this works out, we won't have to fight Jupiter anymore, right,
Domon...
Who knows... But if we crush them all, we won't have to worry
about buying time!
Oh well... Guess I have no choice but to help out.
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
1. Destroy all enemies
1. Akito's Aestivalis is destroyed
What are you doing! I said not to shoot him down!
All right! We cleaned 'em up! How're things on your end!
Hmph, this had better work.
But... how?
With a Boson Jump.
